basic_info.description: Welcome to 81 Nebraska Street. This spacious four-bedroom, two-bath home combines comfort, functionality, and San Francisco charm. Enjoy parking for two cars, ample basement storage, and a backyard retreat that's perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The versatile layout provides room for both everyday living and future possibilities.    Nestled in the heart of Bernal Heights, the home offers easy access to public transportation and the shops, cafes, and restaurants along Cortland Avenue. Known as San Francisco's backyard, Bernal Hill is lovingly cultivated by residents through its patchwork of neighborhood gardens and stairways, and offers one of the city's most iconic wraparound views. On weekends, you're just minutes from the Alemany Farmers' Market on Saturdays and the Flea Market on Sundays, bringing a small-town spirit to city living. With its welcoming neighborhood vibe, modest yet charming homes, and unbeatable views, 81 Nebraska Street is the perfect opportunity to enjoy the best of Bernal Heights.
